The archive's sha512 matched the registry's "dist.integrity" for @maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet@0.1.4. It was unpacked
into an empty folder of its own and read before anything was copied: no eval, no hidden characters, LF line endings,
no credential the engine's scanner knows.
Copied from the archive unchanged, byte for byte: leaflet-maplibre-gl.js (the same bytes as
dist/leaflet-maplibre-gl.js), LICENSE.
It is a plain script (UMD): it reads the global maplibregl and adds L.maplibreGL to Leaflet — ADR-0013 §1.
Kept in the site itself (ADR-0013), so a visitor's browser asks no third party for it.
tests/test_vendor.py compares every file below with its SHA-256.
